name: SidebarNav
description: An app sidebar with grouped links, an accent pill that glides to the active item, count badges, and a toggle that springs the panel down to an icon rail.
a11yNotes: Renders a <nav> landmark labelled by the workspace title. Items are native buttons with aria-current="page" on the active one; Up/Down/Home/End move focus between items and Tab still works. The collapse toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When collapsed, each item keeps its accessible name through aria-label and a title tooltip, and group headings are hidden from assistive tech. Badges announce "N new". Reduced motion removes the width spring and pill glide.

propsApi.name: groups
propsApi.description: Grouped links: { label, items: { id, label, icon?, badge? }[] }.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called when an item is activated.

propsApi.name: defaultCollapsed
propsApi.description: Start collapsed to the icon rail (uncontrolled).

propsApi.name: onCollapsedChange
propsApi.description: Called when the collapse toggle is used.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Workspace title; also the nav landmark's label.

propsApi.name: showBadges
propsApi.description: Show count badges (a dot when collapsed).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Active pill, icon, and badge color.
